title: Omics time-series program
description: One marine microbial omics time-series program or observatory. One record per file in data/time-series/.

id.description: Stable identifier, also the filename and the URL fragment on the website. Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens. Do not change it after publication: links and citations depend on it.

name.description: Full name of the program or observatory, spelled out.

acronym.description: Short name the program is usually known by.

program-website.description: Main landing page for the program.

additional-websites.description: Further URLs for the same program, when it is documented in more than one place. The first/canonical URL belongs in the primary website field.

affiliated-institutions.description: Institutions and programs that run or fund this observatory, as free text. Institution names contain commas, so this is deliberately not a list.

affiliated-institution-websites.description: Websites of the affiliated institutions, in the same order where possible.

status.description: Whether the observatory is still operating, and whether it is still producing omics data.

sampling-start-year.description: First year of the time series (any kind of sampling, not necessarily omics).

sampling-end-year.description: Last year of the time series, or the string `present` for an ongoing series.

dna-collection-start-year.description: First year in which samples for nucleic-acid sequencing were collected.

dna-collection-note.description: Free text about what started when, for programs where DNA collection began in stages or differs between compartments.

countries.description: Countries operating the program. A list, because a few programs are binational.

ocean-basins.description: Ocean basin(s) or regional sea(s) the sampling sites fall in.

sub-region.description: More specific location: a bay, strait, shelf, transect or named station area.

latitude.description: Representative latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84. For multi-site programs, a central or flagship station.

longitude.description: Representative longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84. East positive.

multiple-sampling-sites.description: True when the program samples more than one station.

sampling-sites-note.description: Description of the station layout: transects, depth gradients, moorings.

sampling-depth.description: Depth range sampled for omics. Surface is shallower than 100 m; deep is below 100 m.

sampling-cadence.description: How often omics samples are taken, at the frequency most representative of the program. Use `notes` for detail.

omics-types.description: Kinds of molecular data the program produces.

data-accessions.description: Public archive accessions holding this program's molecular data: INSDC BioProjects and studies, SRA/ENA/DDBJ runs, PRIDE datasets.

data-accessions-note.description: Anything about data availability that is not itself an accession.

notes.description: Anything else worth recording about this program.

accession.description: An INSDC BioProject/study accession (PRJNA/PRJEB/PRJEA/PRJDB), an SRA/ENA/DDBJ accession, a PRIDE dataset (PXD), a GenBank nucleotide accession, or a hyphenated range of either. No archive name, no surrounding text.

contacts.description: People to write to about this program. Every entry needs a name or an email; a name without an email is allowed when the address is not known.

note.description: Caveat about reaching this person, e.g. that the address bounced.

publications.description: Example publications, preferably ones showing omics integration. Give a bare DOI (`10.1038/...`) whenever one exists; a plain URL is a fallback for items with no DOI.

oneOf.description: URL for a publication with no DOI

verification.description: Who last checked this record against reality, and when.
